_comment: Verity's plans (issue #33): scripted pressure that aims the Blank at a province for a few days. Each plan starts on its day (in order), then a random plan repeats every repeat_gap days. target: a province id, or a rule: concord_frayest (a Concord province, else exposed_frayest), yours_frayest (your frayest province that is not Hollowmark, else Hollowmark), exposed_frayest (frayest province touching erased land or the Blank's edge), frontier_frayest (frayest province in the region the story opened most recently, else exposed_frayest). Only provinces in open regions are ever targeted (issue #53). per_day: extra Fray per day while it lasts. counter: governor (halved while you have a governor posted there), lamp (cancelled while a Wardlamp burns there), or empty. notice: %s = province name. Story beats can add pressure too: Empire.add_pressure(province_id, label, per_day, days, counter).

plans.label: Verity's chalk lines
plans.notice: Someone has chalked neat lines across %s. The Blank is following them. Verity aims at the Concord first.

plans.label: Verity's surveyors
plans.notice: Quiet surveyors are measuring %s for a clean page. A governor could run them off.

plans.label: Erasure notices, signed V.H.
plans.notice: Polite Erasure notices are nailed to every door in %s. A lit Wardlamp would burn them off.

plans.label: Verity redraws the border
plans.notice: The Blank's edge near %s has been redrawn, very neatly. A governor could hold the old line.

plans.label: Verity's cartographers
plans.notice: Pale cartographers are redrawing the map around %s, leaving it blank. A lit Wardlamp would spoil their survey.
